nodes.name: Line Manager

nodes.description: Approves or rejects requests from their direct team; views the team leave calendar.

nodes.name: HR Officer

nodes.description: Views all requests, configures request types and leave policy, adjusts leave balances, exports reports. Primary business owner of the system.

nodes.name: Executive (Board of Directors)

nodes.description: Final approver for selected request types (e.g. overseas business trips); views consolidated reports.

nodes.name: System Administrator

nodes.title: UC-01
nodes.description: An employee selects a request type, completes the form defined for that type, optionally attaches a file, and submits the request for approval.

nodes.title: UC-02
nodes.description: An employee views the list of requests they have submitted together with the current status of each, and cancels a request that has not yet been approved.

nodes.title: UC-03
nodes.description: An approver reviews a pending request and either approves it or rejects it with a mandatory reason. In a multi-level flow, approval forwards the request to the next approver; at the final level, approval completes the request.

nodes.title: UC-04
nodes.description: An employee edits a request that was rejected and submits it again, which restarts the approval flow from the first level.

nodes.title: UC-05
nodes.description: An approver who will be unavailable delegates their approval authority to another user, so that requests routed to them can still be decided while they are away.

nodes.title: UC-06
nodes.description: An employee views their annual leave position for the current year: total entitlement, days used, and days remaining.

nodes.title: UC-07
nodes.description: An HR officer manually adjusts an employee's annual leave quota, for example to add seniority bonus days or days carried over from the previous year.

nodes.title: UC-08
nodes.description: The system notifies approvers when a request needs their action and notifies employees when their request is approved or rejected, and reminds an approver when a request has been pending for more than 24 hours.

nodes.title: UC-09
nodes.description: A manager or team member views a department or team calendar showing who is absent on which days, so that absences can be anticipated and staffing planned.

nodes.title: UC-10
nodes.description: A user searches and filters requests by person, request type, date range and status, within the scope their role permits.

nodes.title: UC-11
nodes.description: HR and executives view leave statistics by employee, department and month, identify employees close to exhausting their leave or with large unused balances, and export the results to Excel.

nodes.title: UC-12
nodes.description: An administrator manages user accounts, departments, the reporting hierarchy that determines who manages whom, and the role-based permissions that govern what each user may do.

nodes.title: UC-13
nodes.description: HR or an administrator defines request types and their multi-level approval routing through configuration, so that new request types and changed policies do not require code changes.

nodes.title: UC-14
nodes.description: An administrator maintains the public holiday calendar for the year, which the system uses when computing how many leave days a request consumes.

nodes.title: UC-15
nodes.description: A user authenticates to the system using their company email account, ideally reusing the corporate identity the company already operates, and is granted the access their assigned roles permit.

nodes.title: F-01
nodes.description: This feature lets an employee create a request of any configured type, computes how many leave days it consumes, accepts supporting attachments, and gives the employee visibility and control over the request until it is decided. It directly addresses the RFP's first stated problem: employees cannot see where their r…

nodes.title: F-02
nodes.description: This feature routes a submitted request through the approval levels configured for its type and size, records each decision with its author and timestamp, and drives the request to a final Approved or Rejected outcome. It addresses the RFP's second stated problem: managers forget to approve, or approve by email leav…

nodes.title: F-03
nodes.description: This feature holds each employee's annual leave entitlement, deducts days when leave is finally approved, restores them when a request is rejected or cancelled, lets HR adjust a balance manually, and presents total, used and remaining figures. It addresses the RFP's third stated problem: remaining leave is miscalcul…

nodes.title: F-04
nodes.description: This feature tells approvers when a request needs their decision, tells employees when their request has been decided, and reminds an approver when a request has waited longer than 24 hours. It is the mechanism by which the RFP's "managers forget to approve" problem is addressed.

nodes.title: Leave calendar and request lookup
nodes.description: This feature gives a time-based view of who is absent on which days, and a list-based search across requests filtered by person, type, date range and status. It addresses the RFP's fourth stated problem: request history is hard to look up.

nodes.title: Reporting and Excel export
nodes.description: This feature produces leave statistics by employee, department and month, identifies employees close to exhausting their leave or with large unused balances, and exports any report to Excel. nodes.title: F-07
nodes.description: This feature maintains user accounts, departments and the reporting hierarchy, assigns roles, and authenticates users through their company email account. It is the foundation every other feature depends on: it determines who may do what, and who approves whose requests.

nodes.description: This feature holds the configuration that makes the rest of the system flexible: the request types and their field sets, the approval flows and their conditions, and the public holiday calendar. nodes.heading: 2. Main Success Scenario (Basic Flow)

nodes.description: 1. The approver opens the list of requests awaiting their decision.

nodes.heading: 3.1 Alternative Flow A: Rejection
nodes.title: 3.1 Alternative Flow A: Rejection
nodes.description: 1. The system requires a rejection reason; the decision cannot be submitted without one (FR-11).

nodes.heading: 3.2 Alternative Flow B: Annual leave of 2 days or fewer
nodes.title: 3.2 Alternative Flow B: Annual leave of 2 days or fewer
nodes.description: 1. Line manager approval is the only level required (FR-09).

nodes.heading: 3.3 Alternative Flow C: Annual leave of more than 2 days
nodes.title: 3.3 Alternative Flow C: Annual leave of more than 2 days
nodes.description: 1. After line manager approval the request is forwarded to HR (FR-09).

nodes.heading: 3.4 Alternative Flow D: Overseas business trip
nodes.title: 3.4 Alternative Flow D: Overseas business trip
nodes.description: 1. The flow is line manager, then HR, then Executive (FR-10).

nodes.heading: 3.5 Alternative Flow E: Decision by a delegate
nodes.title: 3.5 Alternative Flow E: Decision by a delegate
nodes.description: 1. The delegate holds the current step and may decide in place of the assigned approver (FR-13).

nodes.heading: 4.1 Exception A: Rejection reason omitted
nodes.title: 4.1 Exception A: Rejection reason omitted
nodes.description: 1. The system refuses the decision and re-prompts for the reason (FR-11).

nodes.heading: 4.2 Exception B: Request no longer pending
nodes.title: 4.2 Exception B: Request no longer pending
nodes.description: 1. The system refuses the decision and informs the approver of the current status.

nodes.heading: 4.3 Exception C: Balance insufficient at final approval
nodes.title: 4.3 Exception C: Balance insufficient at final approval

nodes.heading: 4.4 Exception D: Approver unavailable and no delegate
nodes.title: 4.4 Exception D: Approver unavailable and no delegate
nodes.description: 1. The system sends a reminder to the approver (FR-20, UC-08).

nodes.title: 3.1 Alternative Flow A: Resubmitted without changes
